description: LANGUAGE JAVA stored procedures with a Snowpark HANDLER, whose body is Java SOURCE inside a dollar-quoted string. Three shapes: a handler building a nested Map and returning it through a Variant (the body also carries an escaped \" inside a Java string literal, which the dollar-quoted body must pass through untouched), a handler running SQL through session.sql() and reading the Row back, and a handler taking a declared VARCHAR parameter alongside the Session. Each is CALLed and its return value checked. Converted 1:1 from scripting/JavaProcedureTest (now retired); the first two tests asserted only that the answer CONTAINS certain characters, so the converted steps pin the whole value.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE items (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
